scripts.render: pnpm prep && remotion render src/index.ts Intro out/master.mp4 && pnpm encode
scripts.encode: ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/master.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=pc:out_range=tv:in_color_matrix=bt601:out_color_matrix=bt709,format=yuv420p -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 19 -profile:v high -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/littleguys-intro.mp4
